conventions: Read at 32a62f28 against v1.29.0 (agent, 2026-10-27). Not repeated per row: RuntimeError from a C-stack overflow (MP_STACK_CHECK) is I.4(d.1)'s design defect, recorded by report_if_fatal() in the handler that catches it, never a per-site raise; CancelledError delivered at an await is its task's cancellation and propagates by design (a BaseException subclass, extmod/asyncio/core.py:18, so none of this module's eight `except Exception` clauses, :457, :472, :503, :515, :543, :569, :681, :697, swallows it). Small fixed allocations: a *args tuple (py/bc.c:163), a star-call's argument array (py/runtime.c:790-812), an async def's or a generator expression's generator (py/objgenerator.c:53-66), a closure, a heap iterator, a dict view and its 2-tuple per item (py/objdict.c:469, :550-555), a memoryview or its slice (py/objarray.c:216-233, :456-470), a divmod() pair, a boxed float, or a timestamp past 2**30 (shared/timeutils/timeutils.h:86-92); each is fixed per call site, so such a call can raise MemoryError on an exhausted heap. F.2 sends these to I.4(a): a function doomed without memory does not catch, and asyncio primitives are never wrapped as a blanket policy. Where each lands, by context: at construction (inside build_system()) and in a setup() (run_setups() catches nothing, asy_system_service.py:738-744) the raise ends asyncio.run(main()), where the generated boot entry's except BaseException catches it (build/generated_src/sensortask_<device>_main.py:38, emitted by buildgen/codegen.py:867), records the loop end and leaves the armed watchdog to reset; in a supervised task (a reader's _read_loop() or _trigger_loop(), a service loop) the task ends and _log_dead_task()'s except Exception (asy_system_service.py:326) persists it as TASK_RAISED, after which the supervisor restarts the task (I.4(c)); in a timer starter, _run_timer_starter()'s except Exception (asy_system_service.py:436); in a REST handler (a config GET or PUT) Microdot's dispatch_request() catches it (ext/microdot.py:1533) and hands it to the errorhandler registered for Exception (asy_webserver_service.py:617, _handle_unhandled_exception() :791), which persists it and answers 500 (SPECIFICATION.md A.5). An import-time allocation precedes the boot entry's try and is the armed watchdog's alone (WDT armed at sensortask_<device>_main.py:6, I.4(d)). Parameter types are the mypy-checked ones of each signature; D.2 forbids defending against out-of-contract types at run time.
